top_categories.workout_context: 95ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
At Tour of Pembrokeshire, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
At mile 60 of 105, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Tour of Pembrokeshire's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Tour of Pembrokeshire. Train it until it feels boring.
10,000ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

Road-specific control matters at Tour of Pembrokeshire. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 105 miles.
10,000ft of climbing makes aerobic ceiling relevant when the grade or pace changes. VO2max work supports those hard moments; sustained climbing and conservative pacing remain the spine.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 10,000ft of climbing on mixed terrain does to your power file on race day.
Low-cadence force work supports 10,000ft of climbing when the grade lowers cadence. Practice controlled torque while preserving good form.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 105 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
105 miles rewards fat oxidation. This volume work shifts your fuel mix so you're still burning fat at hour 5, not bonking at hour 3.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Tour of Pembrokeshire’s 105 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Over Under, and Durability to prepare you for 105 miles of mixed terrain in St Davids, Pembrokeshire, Wales.
